narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video follows a comedic price-comparison challenge where the creator attempts to find the cheapest batteries between a major supermarket chain and a local hardware department store (Xiaobei/Showba). It aims to entertain through high-energy interaction and practical consumer tips.
